leadText: The Pokémon Chronicles theme is an opening and ending theme produced for Pokémon Chronicles. This theme aired as an opening only with the airings of the series. The televised airings instead use the opening theme based on the Pokérap GS. This is currently the only English opening theme in the to have no lyrics.
